title: Crafting a Cinematic Horror Clip in 30 Seconds

scenes.narration: First, we unleash a storm—thunder cracks, lightning slashes across a twisted forest, and wind howls like a hurricane, setting the pulse racing.
scenes.prompt: A dark, gnarled forest at night under a stormy sky, bright lightning bolts illuminating twisted trees, heavy clouds, rain, and visible motion blur of whipping wind, cinematic lighting, high detail, 9:16 vertical format
scenes.motion_direction: slow zoom in on lightning strike with a subtle left-to-right pan

scenes.narration: Next, we blend the terror with surreal, swirling shadows, using quick cuts and motion blur to keep viewers on edge while the wind intensifies.
scenes.prompt: A misty clearing in the forest where shadowy, semi-transparent figures swirl with gusts of wind, motion blur trails, eerie greenish glow, cinematic color grading, 9:16 vertical format
scenes.motion_direction: fast zoom out combined with a radial blur transition to the next scene

scenes.narration: Finally, the storm clears to reveal a mysterious, glowing enchanted kingdom, a calm that feels both magical and unsettling, showing how contrast can heighten the horror experience.
scenes.prompt: A luminous, otherworldly kingdom perched on a cliff as sunrise breaks, towers of crystal and vines, soft golden light, faint mist, subtle sparkle effects, cinematic atmosphere, 9:16 vertical format
scenes.motion_direction: fade-in from black with a gentle upward pan
